instruction: Cinematic film still, medium eye-level shot. Inside a modern high-rise office during the day, the woman in the black blazer (R1) stands on the left in profile, smiling as she shakes hands. Opposite her, the man in the dark suit jacket and pink shirt (R2) stands on the right, also in profile, engaging in the handshake. They clasp right hands over a desk in front of a large window with horizontal blinds. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight, creating a clean, professional atmosphere with neutral tones.
